Kian can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Kian, kian. Script forms are كِيَان, کيان, کیان, कियान.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
